records.claim: Miscarriage is common and can occur in any pregnancy for many different reasons. It is not known if amitriptyline can increase the chance of miscarriage. One study suggested that amitriptyline use to treat migraines might increase the chance of miscarriage. Untreated depression might increase the chance of miscarriage. More information on depression can be found in our sheet here: https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/depression-pregnancy/.
